Execute an R script from shell

Source: R/execute_from_shell.R
Rbatch.Rd

Executes an R script in batch mode. The R code in file is executed in an independent R session, and the console output (including the executed code) is stored in a text file file.path(destdir, outfile).

Rbatch(
  file,
  destdir = ".",
  outfile = paste0(basename(file), ".Rout"),
  timing = TRUE
)

Arguments

file

Path and name of an R script to be executed.

destdir

Output directory for .Rout-file (R console).

outfile

Name of output .Rout file (R console), NOT including folder name - use destdir for that!

timing

Logical: print execution time in console?

Value

Character string: path to the output file.

Details

To avoid that critical warnings remain undetected, outfile is scanned for lines beginning with the string “Warning” after its generation, and a warning is issued if there is at least one such line. (Note that this may fail if your R session is using translations.)
